critical_code_review_comments: server.py forgot-password does not rate-limit — for demo scope this is acceptable, but in prod add throttling per email to prevent token spam.
reset_password token expiry check uses datetime.fromisoformat on stored ISO string — works correctly with UTC-aware timestamp.
Admin RBAC properly enforced across all 4 new endpoints (require_admin dependency).

self-delete guard runs BEFORE last-admin guard — so when only one admin exists (=self), the request returns 400 'Cannot delete your own account' (never reaches last-admin check). This is correct behavior since self-check is stricter.

During testing my initial script demoted admin@glowup.com because 2 admins existed in DB (gopugowda@gmail.com is also admin). I restored admin@ via direct DB fix and rewrote test to be conditional. Recommend main agent verifies gopugowda@gmail.com is an expected user in this env.
